zh-CN.title: 每款头像框重新找回自己的个性
items: 逐一重绘全部头像框，让星轨、声浪、月相、王冠等名称都能被直观看见
小头像保留清晰主符号，大预览会呈现更完整的材质与动态细节
所有设计仍紧贴头像并限制在固定范围内，不会挤占相邻内容

en.title: Every avatar frame has reclaimed its identity
items: Every frame was redrawn so names such as Orbit, Soundwave, Moon, and Crown are immediately recognizable
Compact avatars retain one clear motif while large previews reveal richer material and motion
All designs still hug the portrait and remain inside a fixed footprint without colliding with nearby content
